renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: When joy rises — won, or seen, or remembered from long ago — sit with it till you melt into it: be of that mind. When eating and drinking swell into bright joy, picture the filled state — and great bliss follows.

Taste anything sweet like a song, happiness no one else shares — melt into one selfness, sunk in, and that is selfness. Wherever the mind feels full, hold it right there — there, there, your own form as highest bliss pours forth.

At the edge where sleep has not yet come, where the outer world drops off — send the mind into that state: the highest goddess shines. Stare into the sun, a lamp-flame, the spotted sky — lock the gaze and your own self-form shines. Stare at bones, at anger, at licking, at sky-farers — at gaze-time, the highest finding shines.

Sit soft on one buttock, hands and feet hanging free — from that very seat, the supreme full mind. Sit straight, both arms half-bent, mind the armpit-sky — calm comes as you melt. Fix the gaze on a gross-formed thing and drop it down fast — mind unsupported: walk to Śiva.

paragraphs.text: Joy pops up — scored, spotted, or remembered from way back — meditate it till you dissolve in: run that mind. Eating and drinking bloom into joy-bloat — picture the filled state and great bliss clocks in.

Taste anything good like a track, happiness nobody else gets — sink into one-selfness, locked in, and that's the self. Wherever the mind feels full, pin it there — there, there, your own top-bliss form ships out.

Pre-sleep, outer world powered down — drive the mind into that state: top goddess shines. Sun, lamp-flame, freckled sky — hard-stare and your own self-form shines. Bones, rage, licking, sky-goers — at stare-time the top find shines.

Soft seat, one cheek, hands and feet dangling — from that setup, supreme full mind. Straight spine, half-bent arms, mind the armpit-sky — calm via melting. Hard-stare a gross thing and drop it fast — mind with no support: walk to Śiva.
